title: Convex Equilibrium Potentials for Monge--Amp\`ere: Curvature Bounds and A Posteriori Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Equilibrium neural networks define their hidden state as the fixed point of a contraction, so their effective depth is set at evaluation time rather than by the architecture. Using them for fully nonlinear PDEs raises two issues that explicit networks avoid: second derivatives may grow with the effective depth, and the potential is only ever evaluated approximately. We study nonnegative softplus equilibrium networks with contraction factor $q<1$, a convex class suited to the Monge--Amp\`ere equation. A positivity cancellation in the resolvent shows that the Hessian grows at most like $(1-q)^{-2}$, rather than the $(1-q)^{-3}$ of a direct estimate, and an explicit one-neuron family shows that this exponent is sharp; third derivatives satisfy a sharp $(1-q)^{-3}$ bound. Residual-based a posteriori estimates then control the state, its input derivatives and, in two dimensions, the Hessian determinant at an approximate equilibrium. Combine

translated_title: 用于Monge–Ampère方程的凸平衡势：曲率界与后验评估
translated_abstract: 平衡神经网络将其隐藏状态定义为压缩映射的不动点，因此其有效深度是在评估时确定的，而非由网络架构决定。将这类网络用于完全非线性偏微分方程会带来两个显式网络可以避免的问题：二阶导数可能随有效深度增长，且势函数只能被近似求值。我们研究具有压缩因子 $q<1$ 的非负 softplus 平衡网络，这是一类适合 Monge–Ampère 方程的凸函数类。通过预解算子中的正性抵消，我们证明 Hessian 矩阵至多以 $(1-q)^{-2}$ 的速度增长，而不是直接估计所给出的 $(1-q)^{-3}$，并且一个显式的单神经元函数族表明该指数是最优（不可改进）的；三阶导数则满足一个最优的 $(1-q)^{-3}$ 界。随后，基于残差的后验估计可以控制近似平衡点处的状态、其输入导数，以及在二维情形下 Hessian 行列式的误差。
tldr: 本文针对用于Monge–Ampère方程的凸softplus平衡神经网络，证明了Hessian矩阵关于压缩因子具有最优的 $(1-q)^{-2}$ 增长界，并给出了基于残差的后验估计以控制近似平衡点处的状态及其导数误差。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a sharp $(1-q)^{-2}$ Hessian growth bound for convex softplus equilibrium networks applied to the Monge–Ampère equation, and provides residual-based a posteriori estimates that control the state and its derivatives at an approximate equilibrium.
